name: dkx 160 Compressor
description: The Disk King X, dkx 160 Compressor, inspired by the dbx 160. A VCA compressor/limiter for the MPC. True-RMS detection with automatic attack and release, threshold 10 mV to 3 V, compression 1:1 to infinity, output gain +-20 dB, amber BELOW / red ABOVE lights and a lamp-lit meter.
author: The Disk King
